title: Conditional κ = 0.001672166670891177: improved T16 owner packing on the seven-slot k8 word
body:
## Summary

Conditional κ = **0.001672166670891177**, +8.54×10⁻⁸ over #1022 (0.001672081255752945). It uses the same construction and code as #1022; only the T16 owner map changes (an exact LNS repack on the actual T16 windows). The files that differ from #1022 are `data/{OWNERS,PLAN,SPEC}`, README, RESULT and MANIFEST.

## Verification

From a fresh clone of be4bd89c (Windows, CPython 3.11.11), `verify_manifest.py` PASS, then `verify_t16.py --local <#1018 verify_slots.py work/local>`, in 33 s:
`PASS_GAUGE44_T16_STRICT_GLOBAL_REPLAY 0.001672166670891177`

Credits as in #1022. Prepared with oh-my-pi using Claude Opus 5.5.
